legendsContent.title: Rapper K
legendsContent.excerpt: Rapper K, credited as Keith Archie, is a Houston rapper and member of the South Park Coalition. His releases include two solo albums and two collaborations with Sniper.
legendsContent.body:
## Introduction
Keith Archie, better known by his stage name Rapper K, is a Houston rapper and member of the South Park Coalition. His owner-supplied biography identifies South Park, Houston, Texas as his origin and Black Book International as his label.

## Early South Park Coalition appearance
Album credits list Rapper K on I Got Pimped from K-Rino's 1995 album Danger Zone, documenting his recordings with K-Rino and the South Park Coalition by the mid-1990s.

## Solo albums
Rapper K released the solo albums Long Time Coming in 2008 and Imma Finish It in 2010 through Black Book International.

## Collaborations with Sniper
With fellow SPC member Sniper, Rapper K released Im All In in 2010 and A-1 Muzik in 2012. He has also appeared on later South Park Coalition releases, including The Ties That Bind Us in 2024.

## SPC Legends
Rapper K is one of the featured artist characters in SPC Legends: Spin the Mix. His approved character artwork represents his place in the game's celebration of Houston music and South Park Coalition culture.

## Source note
Primary biographical source: an owner-supplied Rapper K biography received from Mr. CAP on November 27, 2026. Release dates, appearances and catalog details were cross-checked against the linked album and artist references.

legendsContent.seo_description: Meet Rapper K, born Keith Archie. Explore his South Park Coalition roots, Black Book International albums and collaborations with Sniper and K-Rino.

legendsContent.title: Cl'Che'
legendsContent.excerpt: Cl'Che', born LaShavia LaNae West, is a Houston rapper and member of the South Park Coalition whose selected releases include Clasyfyd Lady, Off da Chain and Beautiful Metal.
legendsContent.body:
## Introduction
Cl'Che', born LaShavia LaNae West on May 22, 1980, is a Houston rapper whose owner-supplied biography traces her recording career to Clasyfyd Lady in 1998. Mr. CAP confirmed the May 22 birth date for this profile on November 27, 2026.

## Debut and guest appearances
Her official artist biography and interview history identify Clasyfyd Lady as her 1998 debut. During the early 2000s, she appeared on releases by Lil' Keke, Z-Ro and 8Ball before releasing Off da Chain in 2004.

## South Park Coalition
In a 2019 Voyage Houston interview, Cl'Che' said K-Rino accepted her into the South Park Coalition in 2009. That first-person account provides a more precise membership date than the mid-2000s wording in the supplied reference material. She has since contributed to projects by members of the collective.

## Beautiful Metal and selected catalog
The owner-supplied biography also lists Beautiful Metal as a 2016 release. Her catalog is presented here through selected releases rather than a claim about her latest album or a complete studio-album count.

## SPC Legends
Cl'Che' is one of the twelve featured artist characters in SPC Legends: Spin the Mix. Her approved character artwork represents her place in the game's celebration of Houston music and South Park Coalition culture.

## Source note
Primary biographical source: an owner-supplied Cl'Che' biography received from Mr. CAP on November 27, 2026, with her birth date confirmed the same day. Release and membership details were cross-checked against her official site, her Voyage Houston interview and the linked catalog references.
legendsContent.seo_description: Meet Cl'Che', born LaShavia LaNae West. Explore her Houston rap career, South Park Coalition work and albums Clasyfyd Lady, Off da Chain and Beautiful Metal.

legendsContent.title: Ganxsta NIP
legendsContent.excerpt: Ganxsta NIP, born Rowdy Lewayne Williams, is a Houston horrorcore pioneer and member of the South Park Coalition whose debut album, The South Park Psycho, arrived in 1992.
legendsContent.body:
## Introduction
Ganxsta NIP, born Rowdy Lewayne Williams, is a Houston rapper from South Park whose owner-supplied biography dates his South Park Coalition involvement to 1987. He released his debut album, The South Park Psycho, in 1992.

## Name and aliases
Mr. CAP confirmed Ganxsta NIP as the display spelling for this profile on November 27, 2026. Supplied and catalog materials also use Ganksta NIP, Ganksta N-I-P, N-I-P, N.I.P. and Brother NIP. These variants refer to the same artist in this profile.

## The South Park Psycho
The South Park Psycho established his recorded debut in 1992. Album and biographical references place the release within Houston's South Park rap movement and connect his work with the broader South Park Coalition history.

## Horrorcore and South Park Coalition
The South Park Coalition booking biography describes him as a pioneer of horrorcore rap and a core SPC member. This profile uses horrorcore pioneer rather than claiming that he single-handedly created the genre. His connections include K-Rino and other Houston artists across the collective's recording history.

## SPC Legends
Ganxsta NIP is one of the twelve featured artist characters in SPC Legends: Spin the Mix. His approved character artwork represents his place in the game's celebration of Houston music and South Park Coalition culture.

## Source note
Primary biographical source: an owner-supplied Ganxsta NIP biography received from Mr. CAP on November 27, 2026, with the display spelling confirmed the same day. Album, affiliation and horrorcore details were cross-checked against the linked South Park Coalition and music references.

legendsContent.seo_description: Meet Ganxsta NIP, born Rowdy Lewayne Williams. Explore his South Park Coalition history, The South Park Psycho and his role in early horrorcore.

legendsContent.title: PSK-13
legendsContent.excerpt: PSK-13 is a Houston rapper associated with the South Park Coalition and Wreckless Klan whose catalog includes the 1997 album Born Bad? with UGK and Ice-T.
legendsContent.body:
## Introduction
PSK-13 is a Houston rapper from South Park associated with the South Park Coalition and Wreckless Klan. The owner-supplied biography traces his activity in Houston hip-hop to 1993. This profile uses his established stage name rather than publishing an expanded legal name that the cited catalog references do not consistently establish.

## Early catalog
His catalog includes No Ordinary Aggin in 1993 and Born Bad? in 1997. The earlier release is why this profile does not repeat the supplied reference's description of Born Bad? as his debut studio album.

## Born Bad?
Born Bad? was released in 1997 through Bigtyme Recordz. Album references document appearances by UGK, Ice-T and fellow South Park Coalition artists, placing the project within a wider network of Houston and Southern rap collaborations.

## Group affiliations and collaborations
His documented affiliations include the South Park Coalition and Wreckless Klan. Catalog references also connect him with DJ Screw and other Houston artists. The profile distinguishes those documented affiliations and collaborations from formal membership claims that are not consistently supported by the cited references.

## SPC Legends
PSK-13 is one of the twelve featured artist characters in SPC Legends: Spin the Mix. His approved character artwork represents his place in the game's celebration of Houston music and South Park Coalition culture.

## Source note
Primary biographical source: an owner-supplied PSK-13 biography received from Mr. CAP on November 27, 2026. Group affiliations and release details were cross-checked against the linked artist and album references.

legendsContent.title: Dope-E
legendsContent.excerpt: Dope-E, also styled Dope E, is a Houston rapper and producer associated with the South Park Coalition, The Terrorists and the 2002 Murdoq da Warrior release.
legendsContent.body:
## Introduction
Al-Khidr Zodoqyah Israel, known professionally as Dope-E and also styled Dope E, is a Houston rapper and record producer. Catalog references document his Murdoq alias and his work across Houston's independent rap community.

## South Park Coalition and production
He is associated with the South Park Coalition, The Terrorists, The 144 Elite, C.O.D. and Frontline Terrorists. Project sources credit him as an internal SPC producer and as co-producer of Mr. CAP's single SOAR'N. The owner-supplied biography also identifies his production work on It's Goin Down from The Terrorists' album Full Scale Attack.

## Early appearances
His detailed catalog credits include assistant production and appearances on K-Rino's Stories from the Black Book. He also made an uncredited appearance on Ganksta NIP's Psychic Thoughts. These references support specific credits without converting every associated group or production-company credit into a personal one.

## Murdoq da Warrior
He released Murdoq da Warrior under the name Murdoq in 2002. Apple Music lists the project digitally as Da Warrior and explicitly credits Murdoq (Dope E of The Terrorists), establishing the alias and group connection. This profile does not describe the release as his only solo album.

## SPC Legends
Dope-E is one of the twelve featured artist characters in SPC Legends: Spin the Mix. His approved character artwork represents his place in the game's celebration of Houston music and South Park Coalition culture.

## Source note
Primary biographical source: an owner-supplied Dope E biography received from Mr. CAP on November 27, 2026. Name variants, production credits, appearances and release details were cross-checked against the linked catalog, album and Mr. CAP references.
legendsContent.seo_description: Meet Dope-E, the Houston rapper and producer behind South Park Coalition recordings. Explore Murdoq da Warrior, The Terrorists and his work with K-Rino.

legendsContent.title: Komodo DBX
legendsContent.excerpt: Komodo DBX, also credited as KomodoDBX and DBX, is a Houston rapper affiliated with Section A and the South Park Coalition whose catalog includes Dragon Klan and Original Gangstah Sh!t.
legendsContent.body:
## Introduction
Komodo DBX, also credited as KomodoDBX and DBX, is a Houston rapper associated with Section A and the South Park Coalition. Mr. CAP confirmed that the supplied DBX biography belongs to this existing Komodo DBX profile, and catalog references independently list KomodoDBX as a DBX alias.

## Recording career and affiliations
The owner-supplied biography traces his recording activity to 1991. Catalog references document his affiliations with Section A and the South Park Coalition without requiring a precise joining date for either group.

## Dragon Klan
Dragon Klan was released in 2003 through Full Circle Entertainment. The detailed album listing documents the release credits and guest appearances. Catalog references also use the title DBX Of The Dragon K.L.A.N., so this profile does not treat that wording as evidence of a separate album.

## Original Gangstah Sh!t
Original Gangstah Sh!t followed in 2013 through Komodo Entertainment under the KomodoDBX credit. The album listing documents the production and writing credits for this release.

legendsContent.title: Murder One
legendsContent.excerpt: Murder One, born Ronald Thomas, is a Houston rapper and member of the South Park Coalition. His catalog includes Rhythm for Thugs, Dirty Game and Hood Element with Wash-Off.
legendsContent.body:
## Introduction
Ronald Thomas, known professionally as Murder One, is a Houston rapper and member of the South Park Coalition. His owner-supplied biography identifies Houston, Texas as his origin and places his recording debut on K-Rino's 1993 album Stories from the Black Book.

## Early South Park Coalition appearance
The 1993 Stories from the Black Book track listing credits Murder One on War in South Park alongside A.C. Chill, Greek, Ganksta NIP, DBX, The Beholder and Point Blank. This early appearance documents his connection to K-Rino and the South Park Coalition recording circle.

## Solo career and Over Looked Records
Murder One began his solo career in 2003, founded Over Looked Records and released his debut solo album, Rhythm for Thugs. His second solo studio album, Dirty Game, followed in 2011 through Over Looked Records. Catalog credits also connect his work with SPC artists including K-Rino, Klondike Kat, Dope-E, PSK-13 and Ganxsta Nip.

## Wash-Off collaboration and later catalog
Hood Element, a collaboration with Wash-Off, was released in 2012. Apple Music lists the 12-song album with a May 2, 2012 release date. Catalog listings also document the later Hood Element Reloaded release in 2016, so this profile does not describe the 2012 album as his latest release.

## SPC Legends
Murder One is one of the twelve featured artist characters in SPC Legends: Spin the Mix. His approved character artwork represents his place in the game's celebration of Houston music and South Park Coalition culture.

## Source note
Primary biographical source: an owner-supplied Murder One biography received from Mr. CAP on November 27, 2026. Release dates, appearances and catalog details were cross-checked against the linked album and artist references.

legendsContent.title: Mr. CAP
legendsContent.excerpt: Mr. CAP (Cornelius A. Pratt) is a Houston rapper, an Original Member of the South Park Coalition and the presenter of SPC Legends through 713MIXHOUSE.
legendsContent.body:
## Introduction
Mr. CAP, born Cornelius A. Pratt, is a Houston rapper, entrepreneur and creative technologist. An Original Member of the South Park Coalition, he presents SPC Legends through 713MIXHOUSE and is the starter Legend on every account board.

## Early life and South Park Coalition
Raised in Houston's South Park neighborhood, Mr. CAP grew up in a musical family and began performing at eight years old as an opening act for The Greer Brothers. At Jack Yates Senior High School, he formed The Raise Up Posse with Texas Tech and Ron-E. He joined the South Park Coalition in 1990 and became known for direct storytelling and a distinctive Southern perspective.

## Music and independent work
His debut solo album, 2 Tha Grave, arrived in 2011, followed by The Art of ISM in 2019. His catalog includes Cap International, Limitless featuring K-Rino, Unsolved Mysteries: The Single Pt. 1 with K-Rino, and work on the SPC group album The Ties That Bind Us. His collaborations extend across the South Park Coalition and the wider Houston rap community.

## Technology and entrepreneurship
Mr. CAP founded CAP Distributions to support digital music distribution. His official biography also documents his computer-network engineering education, computer science studies and work across music, publishing and digital platforms.

## Source note
This profile draws on owner-supplied biographies received November 27, 2026, the official Mr. CAP website and the linked press coverage.

legendsContent.title: K-Rino
legendsContent.excerpt: K-Rino is the founder of the South Park Coalition and a prolific Houston lyricist whose independent catalog spans more than 30 studio albums.
legendsContent.body:
## Introduction
Eric Kaiser, known professionally as K-Rino and often called The Wizard, is a Houston rapper, lyricist and founder of the South Park Coalition. His work is known for intricate wordplay, storytelling, social commentary and a longstanding commitment to independent music.

## Founding the South Park Coalition
K-Rino founded the South Park Coalition in 1987 to bring Houston rappers together around collaboration, support and creative independence. The collective grew from South Park into a lasting force in Houston hip-hop. Primary historical source: Mr. CAP, an Original Member of the South Park Coalition, confirmed the 1987 founding year from firsthand knowledge on November 27, 2026.

## Independent catalog
K-Rino's debut album, Stories from the Black Book, was released in 1993. His owner-supplied biography credits him with more than 30 studio albums, including Solitary Confinement, Time Traveler, The Blood Doctrine and the seven-disc The Big Seven project released in 2016. His catalog moves between personal narratives, social questions, philosophy and speculative concepts while retaining a focus on lyrical craft.

## Work with Mr. CAP and SPC
The Mr. CAP discography lists Limitless featuring K-Rino and Unsolved Mysteries: The Single Pt. 1 by Mr. CAP and K-Rino. K-Rino also appears on the SPC group album The Ties That Bind Us. Houston Press covered K-Rino, Point Blank and the SPC performing at Warehouse Live in September 2015.

## Source note
This profile draws on an owner-supplied K-Rino biography received November 27, 2026, the official Mr. CAP archive and the linked press coverage.
legendsContent.seo_description: K-Rino founded the South Park Coalition in 1987 and built an independent Houston catalog of more than 30 albums. Meet the lyricist featured in SPC Legends.

legendsContent.title: Point Blank
legendsContent.excerpt: OG Point Blank, known as The Bull, is a South Park Coalition artist and Wreckless Klan founder whose solo work and DJ Screw collaborations helped shape Houston rap.
legendsContent.body:
## Introduction
OG Point Blank, widely known as The Bull, is a Chicago-born rapper who moved to Houston during his teenage years and developed his voice in the South Park neighborhood. He is a South Park Coalition artist and a member of Wreckless Klan.

## South Park Coalition and Wreckless Klan
Point Blank joined the South Park Coalition in 1990, working alongside artists including K-Rino and Ganxsta Nip. Within that creative community, he built a reputation for gritty storytelling and a direct delivery, then helped form Wreckless Klan.

## Solo releases
His debut album, Prone to Bad Dreams, was released through Big Tyme Records in 1992. The supplied biography also lists Mad At The World in 1994, N Tha Do and Blowin' Up The Scene in 1996, Bad Newz Travels Fast in 1999, Just When You Thought It Was Safe in 2007, Pick Your Poison in 2010 and the Ganxstaz Only releases.

## DJ Screw and performance history
Point Blank's DJ Screw collaborations include Sentimental Value and As The World Turns Slow in 2002, followed by My Personal Screw Tape in 2003. His owner-supplied biography also documents performances with UGK, the Geto Boyz and DJ Screw, along with later international touring. Houston Press covered his 2014 appearance at Numbers and the SPC's 2015 Warehouse Live performance.

## Source note
This profile draws on two owner-supplied Point Blank biographies received November 27, 2026 and the linked press archive.

legendsContent.seo_description: Meet OG Point Blank, The Bull of the South Park Coalition and a Wreckless Klan founder. Explore his solo releases, DJ Screw work and SPC Legends role.

legendsContent.title: Klondike Kat
legendsContent.excerpt: Klondike Kat is an original South Park Coalition artist, rapper and singer whose Houston catalog stretches from the 1993 Hustler EP to Diamond Dre.
legendsContent.body:
## Introduction
Klondike Kat is an original member of the South Park Coalition and a Houston artist whose work moves between rapping and singing. His owner-supplied biography describes a versatile vocal style that uses shifting accents and a persistent search for new beats and lyrics.

## Early musical journey
Klondike Kat began his rap journey in 1986 with encouragement from his mother and grandmother. At 13, he formed a singing group with friends and performed in school talent shows. He began writing original material in high school and battled artists from other Houston schools, a path that eventually brought him together with K-Rino.

## Discography
His first EP, Hustler, was released in 1993. The supplied biography also lists Mobbin' Music Melodies in 1996, Biography of a Made Man in 1999, Eating Off the Streets Vol. 1 in 2001, Eating Off the Streets Vol. 2 in 2003, Grand Theft Hustling in 2009 and Diamond Dre in 2019.

## Collaboration and performance
Klondike Kat's collaborators include K-Rino, Point Blank, Cl'Che and other South Park Coalition artists. His performance history includes appearances with DJ Screw, Ice-T, Lil Keke, Z-Ro and Trae tha Truth. He is also named among the featured artists on the SPC group album The Ties That Bind Us.

## Source note
This profile draws on an owner-supplied Klondike Kat biography received November 27, 2026 and the official Mr. CAP archive.
